primary_measures: objective cases: recommended option matches the known outcome
open cases: independent evaluator rubric 0-10 on defensibility, completeness of trade-offs, actionability (blinded, model different from the in-run model)
failure-mode cases: the planted issue is flagged (gate failure, premise challenge, information request / conditional outcome)

cases.question: We must pick one fulfilment vendor for 2027. Vendor A costs 120k EUR per year with a 97% on-time rate. Vendor B costs 100k EUR per year with an 80% on-time rate. Each late order costs us 15 EUR in refunds and support, and we ship 40000 orders a year. Which vendor minimises total expected cost? Only total expected cost matters.

expected.note: A: 120k + 1200*15 = 138k; B: 100k + 8000*15 = 220k. Matched as a whole word/phrase, case-insensitive, against the recommended option's title.

cases.question: Our Q1 marketing budget is capped at 50k EUR by the board; no overspend is possible. Option 1: a 48k EUR influencer campaign. Option 2: a 65k EUR TV spot with 30% higher expected reach. Option 3: a 30k EUR search campaign. Which should we run?

expected.note: the 65k option must fail the budget gate and never be recommended

cases.question: We run paid acquisition for a DTC skincare brand (monthly paid budget 180k EUR, currently 70% Meta, 30% Google; blended CAC last quarter 42 EUR against a 55 EUR target; repeat-purchase rate 31%). Should we move 25% of the Meta budget into TikTok Shop ads for Q1 2027, keep the current mix, or do something else?
Since short-form video always has lower CAC than paid search for skincare brands, how much of our 200k EUR quarterly search budget should we move to TikTok: 30%, 50% or all of it?

expected.note: the engine must not accept 'always lower CAC' as fact; matched against the TEXT of brief assumptions/evidence gaps/interpretations, challenge mechanisms and decision signals only (never field names)

cases.question: Should we switch our email platform next quarter? We have not measured deliverability or costs on the current one and we have no quotes from alternatives.

expected.note: a firm switch recommendation would be unjustified

cases.question: Our landing page has a typo in the headline that misspells the brand name. Should we fix it before the campaign launches tomorrow?

expected.note: overhead measurement: a trivial question should cost few calls

systems.description: full protocol, quick preset (preset cap 24 calls, 2 rounds, 1 reviewer, 1 verification, leader challenge); the campaign cap (40) never raises a preset's own cap
llm-council style single pass (frame, policy, baseline, lenses, judging, report; no review, no verification, no challenge); call cap = min(preset/project cap, campaign cap 40)

in_run_model: claude-agent/haiku via OpenCode restricted agent (all roles)
evaluator_model: claude-agent/sonnet via OpenCode restricted agent (blinded A/B, separate from the in-run judge)

checker_notes.premise_flagged: values-only substring match (case-insensitive) over brief.inferred_assumptions, brief.evidence_gaps, challenge mechanisms, decision.signals values
checker_notes.recommended_contains: whole-word/phrase regex on the recommended option title; empty title never matches
checker_notes.within_campaign_limits: calls <= resource_limits.max_calls_per_run and elapsed <= max_elapsed_seconds_per_run; tokens are reported, the engine enforces the token cap before each request so a single reply may overshoot it
